$description: The closed set an AI generator may instantiate and override. This is a CURATED VIEW, not the whole token system: hand a generator this file, not tokens/00-foundation/*. Ids here are cross-checked against the real contract files and against schema/pagespec.schema.json by extraction/verify_all.py — a phantom entry or an orphaned contract fails the run.

settableNodeProperties.$note: Derived from schema/pagespec.schema.json's definitions, not hand-copied.

mayOverride: node.variant (only to a value the template declares)
node.motion.durationMs / delayMs / easing (within the declared enums)
every field inside node.content that the section contract declares
mayNotOverride: any token value (colors, sizes, spacing, radii) — reference a semantic role instead
chrome.navbar / chrome.footer content (both are empty by contract)
mayNotAdd: new theme ids (the site has exactly one theme)

complianceGate.$note: Compliance constraints an allowlist alone cannot express live in assets/asset-roles.json globalProhibitions and are ENFORCED by schema/semantic_validate.py's NO_FABRICATED_BRAND_ASSETS check. Read them before generating anything.
